sources.title: GitHub - vinish-v/vini-ai- · GitHub
sources.snippet: Vini AI Vini AI is a Windows desktop AI agent workspace built around a real local runtime. It rebrands and extends the Agent Zero runtime into a Vini AI product experience with a desktop shell, live browser/desktop surfaces, provider configuration, local data persistence, connectors, voice work, and a scoped Windows host bridge.
